SHARED-F-2-S94.title: Consent Data Schema and Storage Contract Definition
SHARED-F-2-S94.description: Define MongoDB schema and data contracts for consent records, including tier level, de-identification status, session linkage, timestamps, and audit metadata to ensure consistent persistence and retrieval.

SHARED-F-2-S95.title: Consent Tier Enforcement Core Logic Hardening
SHARED-F-2-S95.description: Enhance ConsentService to strictly enforce Tier 1 (de-identified only) and Tier 2 (identified allowed) rules across all data flows, including validation gates before any persistence or downstream service calls.

SHARED-F-2-S96.title: Consent Service Integration with Debug Logger and Safety Systems
SHARED-F-2-S96.description: Integrate consent decisions with debug logging and safety service to ensure all stored logs respect consent tier and that emergency-triggered sessions override storage rules appropriately while maintaining audit trace.

SHARED-F-2-S97.title: Consent Framework Unit and Integration Test Suite
SHARED-F-2-S97.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier enforcement, de-identification behavior, API responses, and cross-service interactions (lead capture, unknown questions, logging).
